edges.reason: fromBankroll modifier requires msg.sender to be a whitelisted bankroll address before execute() runs.
fromBankroll modifier validates msg.sender before bankrollExternalUpdateTokens mutates contractBalance.
onlyOwnerOrBankroll checks msg.sender against owner/bankroll when pausing the game.
onlyOwnerOrBankroll checks msg.sender against owner/bankroll when resuming the game.
changeOwner is gated on msg.sender being owner or bankroll.
changeBankroll is gated on msg.sender being owner or bankroll.
onlyOwner guards msg.sender for the max-profit-percent setter.
onlyOwner guards msg.sender for ownerSetMinBet.
onlyOwner guards msg.sender for ownerSetZlotsAddress.
Constructor sets owner from msg.sender, seeding the whole authorization model.
finishSpin passes msg.sender as the target spin owner into _finishSpin.
Randomness is derived from past block data, making the outcome dependent on block/timestamp context.
contractBalance mapping is incremented by addContractBalance.
contractBalance mapping is decremented by subContractBalance.
setMaxProfit derives maxProfit[divRate] from contractBalance[divRate].
getMaxProfit computes the cap from contractBalance[divRate].
maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse is a factor in setMaxProfit.
maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse is a factor in getMaxProfit.
setMaxProfit performs raw contractBalance * percent multiplication that can overflow.
getMaxProfit performs raw contractBalance * percent multiplication that can overflow.
betIsValid modifier on _spinTokens calls getMaxProfit to bound the wager.
_spinTokens calls addContractBalance before resolving the spin.
_finishSpin requests the winning payout through RequestBankrollPayment.
_finishSpin calls random() to generate the spin result.
random() delegates to maxRandom() for the hashed value.
WithdrawAndTransferToBankroll calls WithdrawToBankroll after withdrawing dividends.
WithdrawToBankroll performs the native ETH transfer to the main bankroll.
External Zethr.withdraw() call is made before the ETH sweep, giving the callee execution control.
RequestBankrollPayment makes an external token-bankroll call whose callee regains control.
_finishSpin externally calls payOutWinner on the jackpot contract during payout.
setupBankrollInterface externally queries the main bankroll for the tier address list.
_spinTokens maps divRate to a tier via ZethrTierLibrary.getTier.
ownerSetMaxProfitAsPercentOfHouse refreshes setMaxProfit for each tier.
bankrollExternalUpdateTokens recomputes maxProfit after the balance change.
getZethrTokenBankroll resolves the tier with getTier(divRate).
execute() forwards the assembled TKN struct into _spinTokens.
finishSpin delegates to the private _finishSpin implementation.
_finishSpin uses SafeMath.mul for profit multipliers.
_finishSpin uses SafeMath.div for fractional multipliers.
owner state variable is overwritten in changeOwner after the authorization check.
owner state variable is the authority compared against msg.sender in the owner setter.
bankroll state variable also authorizes changeOwner and can be rotated by the bankroll.
bankroll state variable is overwritten in changeBankroll.
gameActive gates whether _spinTokens accepts the spin.
gameIsActive modifier requires gameActive for finishSpin.
pauseGame writes gameActive = false.
resumeGame writes gameActive = true.
playerSpins mapping is read and rewritten when a new spin is stored.
playerSpins[target] is read and nulled out inside _finishSpin to block re-entrant double payouts.
zlotsJackpot address is used for getJackpot and payOutWinner during resolution.
zlotsJackpot is set by the owner setter.
UsedBankrollAddresses[tier] selects the contract that receives the payout request.
UsedBankrollAddresses[0] is the destination of the ETH sweep.
ValidBankrollAddress mapping is the access-control lookup for the fromBankroll modifier on execute.
ValidBankrollAddress mapping is the access-control lookup for bankrollExternalUpdateTokens.
minBet state variable is written by ownerSetMinBet.
random() output flows from the blockhash-based value, the weak randomness source.
The jackpot payout callee could re-enter finishSpin while settlement is in progress.
betIsValid validates the _betSize parameter before _spinTokens proceeds.
divRate parameter is passed to getTier for bankroll tier selection.
TKN parameter fields feed the spin record and balance updates.
target parameter indexes playerSpins and receives payouts in _finishSpin.
result local drives the branch selection for payout categories.
profit local is forwarded as the payout token amount.
tier parameter selects UsedBankrollAddresses[tier].
to parameter is forwarded as the gameRequestTokens recipient.
tokens parameter is forwarded as the gameRequestTokens amount.
blockn parameter is hashed into the pseudo-random value.
entropy parameter is mixed into the randomness hash.
upper parameter is the modulo bound of the random result.
newMaxProfitAsPercent is validated and stored in the owner setter.
newMinimumBet is stored into minBet by the owner setter.
zlotsAddress is stored into zlotsJackpot by the owner setter.
_newOwner is written into the owner state variable.
_newBankroll is written into the bankroll state variable.
_from is copied into the TKN sender field.
_value is copied into the TKN value field and becomes the wager.
ZethrMainBankrollAddress is called to obtain the bankroll address list.
i indexes the loop that whitelists all seven bankroll addresses.
winner parameter is the payout recipient in payOutWinner.
newBalance is written into contractBalance[divRate].
spin local struct supplies tokenValue, blockn and tier during settlement.
getTier return value is stored into spin.tier for later payout routing.

normalization_plan.reason: The wager parameter is only meaningful inside the betIsValid check applied to _spinTokens.
divRate exists solely to resolve a bankroll tier through getTier.
The TKN struct is consumed directly by _spinTokens to build the spin record.
target is the player index used exclusively by _finishSpin.
result is a transient value computed and consumed entirely within _finishSpin.
profit exists only to be forwarded into the RequestBankrollPayment payout call.
tier selects the bankroll address inside RequestBankrollPayment.
to is forwarded as the recipient of the gameRequestTokens external call.
tokens is forwarded as the amount of the gameRequestTokens external call.
blockn is hashed inside maxRandom as the block entropy source.
entropy is hashed inside maxRandom as additional entropy.
upper is the modulo bound used by random().
The percent parameter is validated and stored by the owner setter.
The minimum bet parameter is consumed by ownerSetMinBet.
The jackpot address parameter is consumed by ownerSetZlotsAddress.
The new owner parameter is written by changeOwner.
The new bankroll parameter is written by changeBankroll.
_from is only used to populate the TKN struct inside execute().
_value is only used to populate the TKN struct inside execute().
The main bankroll address is only used by setupBankrollInterface.
The loop index exists solely inside setupBankrollInterface.
winner is the recipient argument of the payOutWinner external call.
newBalance is only assigned into contractBalance by bankrollExternalUpdateTokens.
The spin struct local is read and cleared inside _finishSpin.
